build.summary: V29 is done and all four discriminators pass. The default first-use check is now chosen by route through the new AssemblyOptions::default_first_use_check. The coloured route uses MultiColouring with any back end (dense LU or band) and any execution. The dense route keeps Sample(8). FA, FA_P and MC_P stay selectable. A multi-colouring first-use check builds its colourings in new(), so the first linearization allocates nothing for them (0 allocations, against 12 when MC is requested later). The rustdoc states what MC detects on the V26 corpus and what it misses (cancelling couplings and entry collapse, L-0338), and that FA or FA_P is exact up to rounding. The Jacobian arithmetic is unchanged. Commit A came before any client edit. A and B are the same recording program run before and after the change: 36 identity runs are bit-identical between them, and only the first-use check counters change. On the 4846-case corpus, 9693 of 9693 decisions match V26, and the only miss is the known rounding-limited case. One test comment was edited, with its reason listed. The loop checker exits 1 on the expected pins only.

Loop checker exit 1, reported verbatim: 'ValueError: implementation changed; rerun affected tests/update checkpoint: crates/rodas5p-integrators/src/stage_clients/assembly.rs'. The non-stopping copy names three pinned files this node changed: assembly.rs, assembly/engine.rs and tests/stage_clients_assembly_identity.rs. The orchestrator updates CHECKPOINT.json at merge.

No file named PROTOCOL.json was written. The protocol choices were committed before the first run in NOTES.txt entry 1 (ec284167) and in the recording program (f1eb5118). This deviation of form is recorded in RESULTS.json.

Outside the corpus, MC is not a superset of Sample(8). In the three constructed entry-collapse cases of L-0338, Sample(8) detects (column 41 is one of its samples) and MC passes. This is stated in the rustdoc and REPORT_KO.md, and pinned by the test the_limits_stated_for_the_default_are_real.

Design choice made in the change: a client whose first-use check is MC or MC_P builds its further colourings in AssemblyStageClient::new (Engine::prepare_multi is now pub(super)). This keeps the documented rule that sequential clients allocate nothing after new(). It changes neither counters nor bits.

The V08 facade runner (jacobian_assembly/runner, outside this node's write paths) uses the default options. Its banded case now runs MC at first use, so its verification_rhs_calls change; it was not re-run.
The logs total 18 MB, mostly the corpus records of omit1024.
rulings: The identity-test comment at line 608 (stage_clients_assembly_identity.rs) was the only line of an existing test that called Sample(8) the default, so only that comment was reworded. Its assertions are unchanged.

The V08 and V26 measurement programs (stage_clients_assembly_measure.rs, check_corpus.rs, check_measure.rs) name Sample(8) explicitly and are frozen evidence of those nodes, so they were left unedited.

Commit A and B are the same recording program run before and after the change, with source sha256 43f68080… in both. Every client is built with the default options and with_first_use_check is never called.
